attributes.Notes: Transcript-level Salmon quantification against this run's de novo assembly (evigene okayset), not a reference transcriptome.

GCPercent.note: FastQC on the raw reads; single-end runs write it on the sample row, paired-end on <sample>_1 (@R1)

F_bp.note: mean read-1 length (FastQC per-read row, else the single-end sample row)

PseudoalignedPercent.note: reads Salmon mapped back to the de novo assembly

Strandedness.note: from Salmon's library type code (no RSeQC in this pipeline)

deliberately_unmapped.why: Read through $derived.strandedness, which turns Salmon's code into forward, reverse or unstranded.
